name: mealie-10704dc
title: shopping_list_items.food_id is a foreign key without an index, filtered by 2 endpoint(s)

criteria.unit: session median (each session: a fresh database, the same data, warm-up then samples)
criteria.order: alternating base and candidate, which goes first drawn from a seed
criteria.test: exact one-sided permutation test on session medians
criteria.no_relevant_change: the 95% bootstrap interval of the relative effect over sessions lies inside +-20%
criteria.mechanism: when the change declares one (an index), the engine must show it used during the measured calls
criteria.functional: every measured call succeeds and returns the same result on both sides (canonical JSON digest)
criteria.control: A/A: 2 base sessions against 2 more, |effect| below 10%
criteria.confirmation: 4 new sessions per arm in a new order, improved again at alpha 0.05 / (candidates confirmed at this commit)
criteria.scope: the declared operation, data and engine; no claim about other endpoints or production

reasons: GET /api/foods/empty: session medians 215.24 -> 207.14 ms (+4% faster), permutation p = 0.0286 (slower: 1), 95% interval of the effect [+1%, +13%]
no change of 20% or more either way
caveats: {'shopping_list_items': 200000}, measured in a sandbox; production effect not yet observed
measured on postgres, the running system's engine
the project's tests on both sides: matrix entry 1 of 2 (Database=postgres) (part of the suite)
verdict.scope: GET /api/foods/empty on {'shopping_list_items': 200000}, PostgreSQL in a sandbox, inside the test suite; not a claim about other endpoints, other data or production
